reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Park Gate Talks 002
materials.text: A family is at the park gate. Choose the best reply in each short talk.

questions.prompt: Dad: Are you ready? Child: ____
questions.explanation: A回答是否准备好；B说树，C说食物喜好，未答ready。

questions.prompt: Child: What is that? Dad: ____
questions.explanation: B给出动物名称，回答What；A状态、C感谢均不答物品。

questions.prompt: Dad: Do not run here. Child: ____
questions.explanation: C接受不要跑的指令；A颜色、B名字均不合。

questions.prompt: Child: Can you swim? Dad: ____
questions.explanation: A回答能力can；B人物关系、C位置不答能力。

questions.prompt: Dad: Let us go home. Child: ____
questions.explanation: B接受回家建议；A年龄、C物品名称不回应建议。

materials.title: Dress Up Corner 002
materials.text: At the dress-up corner, choose a different answer for each question. Answers: A. It is blue. B. They are shoes. C. It is on the chair. D. Yes, I do. E. She is my sister.

questions.prompt: What colour is the hat?
questions.explanation: A答帽子颜色；B物品复数、C位置、D是否喜欢、E身份都未答颜色。

questions.prompt: What are these?
questions.explanation: B答复数物品是什么；A颜色、C位置、D是非、E人物身份均不合。

questions.prompt: Where is my coat?
questions.explanation: C答外套位置；A颜色、B鞋子、D是否、E姐妹关系都未答Where。

questions.prompt: Do you like this dress?
questions.explanation: D答是否喜欢裙子；A颜色、B鞋子、C位置、E身份不回答喜好问句。

questions.prompt: Who is the girl in the red dress?
questions.explanation: E说明女孩身份；A颜色、B鞋子、C位置、D是非不答Who。

materials.title: Baby Rabbit Care 002
materials.text: We have a baby rabbit. Its name is Snow. It is white, but its ears are grey. Every afternoon, I give it water. My brother gives it some grass. Snow sleeps in a box near the kitchen. We do not put the box in the sun. Snow likes a cool place.

questions.prompt: Snow is a baby rabbit.
questions.explanation: A正确：首句baby rabbit及名字Snow相连；B否认身份。

questions.prompt: Snow has white ears.
questions.explanation: B正确：耳朵是grey；A将身体白色套到耳朵。

questions.prompt: The writer gives Snow water in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: A正确：Every afternoon给水；B与时间和行为矛盾。

questions.prompt: The writer’s brother gives Snow bread.
questions.explanation: B正确：哥哥给grass；A把草换成面包。

questions.prompt: The box is in the sun.
questions.explanation: B正确：原文不把盒放太阳下；A忽略do not。

materials.title: Reading Under Table 002
materials.text: Today is a hot day. Dad makes a little house for us with a table and a sheet. The sheet is over the table. My sister takes a storybook into the house. I take a small fan. We sit on a mat and read. Mum puts two cups of water outside our house. We can see her feet under the sheet.

questions.prompt: Dad makes a house with a table and a sheet.
questions.explanation: A正确：材料直接说明搭建物品；B与原文相反。

questions.prompt: The sheet is under the table.
questions.explanation: B正确：sheet在over the table；A把上下颠倒。

questions.prompt: The writer takes a storybook.
questions.explanation: B正确：姐姐拿故事书，作者拿扇子；A混淆人物分工。

questions.prompt: The children sit on a mat.
questions.explanation: A正确：sit on a mat明确位置；B否认给定动作。

questions.prompt: Mum puts water inside the little house.
questions.explanation: B正确：水放outside；A将外面换成里面。

units.title: 种子借阅台的三个盒子

materials.title: Seed Library Desk 002
materials.text: There is a seed desk in our school library. Three boxes stand on it. The small box has bean seeds, the round box has flower seeds, and the long box has empty paper bags. Children may take one bag of seeds on Friday. They must write their names in a book first. They do not need to pay. Miss Zhou asks them to draw their plants after four weeks. The pictures will go on the library wall. Children do not have to bring the plants back.

questions.prompt: Where is the seed desk?
questions.explanation: A首句学校图书馆；B花店、C车站均未提。

questions.prompt: What is in the long box?
questions.explanation: B长盒装空纸袋；A在小盒；C是将来展示作品。

questions.prompt: What must children do before taking seeds?
questions.explanation: C先在本上写名；A画植物在四周后；B不需付款。

questions.prompt: When will children draw their plants?
questions.explanation: A材料明确四周后；B取种前时间、C一天后均不符。

questions.prompt: What should children bring back?
questions.explanation: B作品将贴图书馆墙上；A明确不用带植物回来；C长盒留借阅台。

materials.title: Swimming Bus Change 002
materials.text: Our class has a swimming lesson every Wednesday. We usually catch the school bus outside the music room. This week, workers are painting that wall. The bus will wait by the big tree instead. We must arrive at nine ten. The driver leaves at nine fifteen. We need a towel and a swimming cap. The pool has spare towels, but it has no spare caps. We can eat our snacks after the lesson, not on the bus.

questions.prompt: The class swims every Wednesday.
questions.explanation: A正确：every Wednesday直接给出；B与频率信息冲突。

questions.prompt: This week the bus waits outside the music room.
questions.explanation: B正确：本周改在big tree旁；A沿用通常地点，忽略临时变化。

questions.prompt: Children must arrive five minutes before the bus leaves.
questions.explanation: A正确：9:10到、9:15开，相差五分钟；B否认这个时间关系。

questions.prompt: Children can borrow a swimming cap at the pool.
questions.explanation: B正确：泳池没有备用帽；A把备用毛巾当备用帽。

questions.prompt: Children may eat snacks on the bus.
questions.explanation: B正确：只能课后吃，不能车上吃；A忽略not on the bus。

units.title: 海边石潭寄来的明信片

materials.title: Rock Pool Postcard 002
materials.text:
Dear Leo,
We visited the beach this morning. The sea was far from the rocks because the tide was low. Our guide showed us little pools between the rocks. My cousin wanted to put a small crab in her bucket. The guide asked her to leave it in its home. We watched it move under a stone instead. I took a picture without touching it. Then we collected three plastic bags from the sand and put them in a bin. We washed our hands before lunch. We did not collect shells because some small animals might still be living in them.
Love,
Amy

questions.prompt: Amy visited the beach in the morning.
questions.explanation: A正确：this morning明确时间；B与来信信息相反。

questions.prompt: The guide asked Amy’s cousin to keep a crab in her bucket.
questions.explanation: B正确：向导要求leave it in its home；A把阻止带走变成要求带走。

questions.prompt: Amy touched the crab before taking its picture.
questions.explanation: B正确：without touching明确未碰；A捏造拍前触碰。

questions.prompt: They picked up plastic rubbish from the sand.
questions.explanation: A正确：收集三个塑料袋丢进桶；B否认已做的清理。

questions.prompt: They left the shells because animals might be inside.
questions.explanation: A正确：末句给出可能仍有动物的原因；B否认原文因果。

materials.title: Theatre Shadow Test 002
materials.text: Our class is making a shadow play about a bird. We put a white sheet across a frame and a lamp behind it. At first, the bird looked much larger than the paper tree. Jay thought we needed a bigger tree. Ms Lin asked us to try moving the bird away from the lamp and closer to the sheet. Its shadow became smaller. We kept the old tree. Later, one wing bent and made a strange shadow. We used a thin stick to hold it straight. On show day, everyone will stay behind the sheet. The audience will see the shadows, not the paper bird or our hands.

questions.prompt: The class is making a play about a bird.
questions.explanation: A正确：开篇about a bird；B与主题矛盾。

questions.prompt: Moving the bird closer to the sheet made its shadow larger.
questions.explanation: B正确：影子became smaller；A将结果反向。

questions.prompt: The class made a bigger tree after the test.
questions.explanation: B正确：保留old tree；A把Jay初始想法当成最终行动。

questions.prompt: A thin stick helped keep the wing straight.
questions.explanation: A正确：细棍支撑翅膀；B否认明确修正方法。

questions.prompt: The audience will watch the children’s hands in front of the sheet.
questions.explanation: B正确：人在幕后，观众只看影子；A同时弄错位置与观看对象。

materials.title: Station Clock Letter 002
materials.text:
Dear Grandpa,
We almost missed our train yesterday. The clock above the waiting-room door stopped at ten twenty. Dad looked at it and said that we still had forty minutes. I checked the time on the station screen. It was already ten fifty. Our train was due at eleven. We asked a member of staff before running to a platform, because the platform number on our old ticket had changed. She directed us to Platform Four and called ahead for us. We arrived before boarding closed. Dad later reported the broken clock. He said a useful sign should be checked as carefully as a train. I was glad I looked at a second source instead of arguing about whose watch was right.
Love,
Ben

questions.prompt: The waiting-room clock showed ten twenty because it had stopped.
questions.explanation: A正确：钟停在10:20；B否认停钟原因。

questions.prompt: The station screen showed that the train would leave in forty minutes.
questions.explanation: B正确：屏幕10:50、火车11:00，剩十分钟；A沿用爸爸误判四十分钟。

questions.prompt: The family checked the platform with a member of staff.
questions.explanation: A正确：先问员工因旧票站台变更；B与求助行为相反。

questions.prompt: They boarded after the boarding gate had closed.
questions.explanation: B正确：before boarding closed已到；A将before颠倒为after。

questions.prompt: Ben found it helpful to check another source of time.
questions.explanation: A正确：末句庆幸核对第二来源；B与自述收获相反。

materials.title: Community Oven Letter 002
materials.text:
Dear Sara,
Our community kitchen has one large oven. Last month, two cooking groups arrived at the same time because one used a paper diary and the other used a phone calendar. Each thought its own booking was the only one. We now keep one booking board beside the kitchen door. A volunteer writes confirmed times on it after checking both groups’ requests. People can still ask by phone, so nobody needs a phone app. The board also includes ten minutes between groups for cleaning. Last Saturday, our bread took longer than expected. We told the next group early and helped clean the tables while it prepared its ingredients. The board cannot prevent every delay, but it makes the plan and the contact person clear.
Best wishes,
Nina

questions.prompt: The two groups originally used different booking records.
questions.explanation: A正确：一方纸日记、一方手机日历；B否认分散记录。

questions.prompt: People must now use a phone app to request the oven.
questions.explanation: B正确：仍可电话申请，无需应用；A与nobody needs a phone app矛盾。

questions.prompt: The board includes time for cleaning between groups.
questions.explanation: A正确：组间十分钟清洁；B与明确安排相反。

questions.prompt: Nina’s group hid its delay from the next group.
questions.explanation: B正确：提前通知下一组；A将told early说成隐瞒。

questions.prompt: The board guarantees that no cooking session will run late.
questions.explanation: B正确：末句不能防止每次延误；A将明确有限作用夸为保证。
